name: Musikschule City West (Musikschule Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf)

conditions.requirements: AV MuS-Honorare expires on 31.12.2026; 2027 conditions yet to be published.

summary_en: District music school with three sites and a dedicated strings department. No vacancy listed on 2026-10-15; the Honorarkraft entry says none, so approach the strings head directly.

name: Junge Deutsche Oper (Deutsche Oper Berlin)
summary_en: Education department of the Deutsche Oper with workshops and partnership projects for schools and nurseries. No vacancy or freelance call published.
instruments_detail: orchestral instruments (school visits by orchestra players)

name: Universität der Künste Berlin (Fakultät Musik)

conditions.pay: 46,81 (Berlin minimum for a Lehrauftrag, FU reference)

summary_en: Arts university with a pre-college institute (Julius-Stern-Institut) for about 70 young students. No Lehrauftrag advertised; the only current ad is for a chancellor.

name: Kammerorchester Charlottenburg (Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Amateur chamber orchestra at the music school, rehearsing on Wednesdays at 19:00. No coaching or conductor call published.

name: Freies Orchester Berlin
summary_en: Community amateur symphony orchestra with regular section rehearsals. The page invites new players only; no coach or conductor wanted.

name: Jugendorchester Charlottenburg (JuO, Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Youth symphony orchestra (ages 15 to 22) of the district music school, rehearsing on Tuesdays. No coaching call published.

name: Nelson-Mandela-Schule (staatliche internationale Schule)
summary_en: Bilingual German/English state school with its own orchestra and an in-house music school (Mendelssohn-Bartholdy-Musikschule) teaching violin and piano. No vacancy listed.

name: Musikschule Philharmonika Berlin

offer.title: Piano teacher wanted now (the jobs page accepts applications by email)

contract.evidence: Wir bieten eine faire Vergütung auf Honorarbasis.

summary_en: Private music school in Wilmersdorf (with a second site in Spandau) teaching violin, viola on request, piano and more. Its jobs page invites applications by email and pays on a fee basis.

name: Musik- und Kunstschule Berlin | Atelier der Sinne
summary_en: Private music and art school in the Altes Ackerbürgerhaus in Charlottenburg with a dedicated violin programme. No job page found.

name: Musikschule Lebenstraum
summary_en: Small private music school in Charlottenburg offering violin and viola lessons alongside many other instruments. No job offer found.

name: Internationale Musikschule Berlin (IMS)
summary_en: International music school run by a violinist, with violin lessons in German and English at several Berlin sites, including international schools. No job offer found.

name: Berliner Mädchenchor (Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Girls' choir school for ages 5 to 35 attached to the district music school, teaching music theory, sight-singing and voice training. No teacher call published.

name: Berlin-Musikschule (Wilmersdorfer Straße)
summary_en: Private music school founded in 2010 offering individual lessons in piano, voice, guitar and other instruments, plus rentable practice rooms. No job page found.

name: Bandits (youth wind orchestra, Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Youngest wind orchestra of the district music school for players aged 8 to 14, rehearsing on Tuesdays in the Otto-von-Guericke-Schule. No conductor or coach call published.

name: Wind-Or-Jester (symphonic wind orchestra, Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Symphonic wind orchestra of about 60 amateur players, active since 1988, rehearsing on Thursdays. It currently seeks players (bassoon, oboe, low brass, percussion); no conductor call.

name: Nota bene (wind and brass ensemble for adult beginners, Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Wind and brass ensemble for adult learners aged about 30 and over, rehearsing on Mondays at the Eichendorff-Grundschule. No conductor call published.

name: Saxonett (saxophone quartets, Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Two saxophone quartets (youth and adult) of the district music school, rehearsing on Fridays. No leader call published.

name: Trombonata (trombone ensemble, Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Trombone ensemble of 10 to 12 players, from alto to contrabass trombone, rehearsing every other Friday at the music school. No leader call published.

name: Madrigalchor Charlottenburg (Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Mixed four-part amateur choir of about 35 singers aged 16 to 66, singing Renaissance to modern works on Thursdays at the Herder-Gymnasium. New members can join at any time.

name: Consortium musicum Berlin (Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Mixed amateur choir founded in 1974 for singers aged about 20 to 55, rehearsing on Thursdays in the Halensee-Grundschule. No conductor call published.

name: Kaktus-Chor (Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Mixed choir for singers aged about 35 to 85 combining art songs, Schlager and music theatre, rehearsing on Wednesdays at the Herder-Gymnasium. No conductor call published.

name: Kissi-Chor (Musikschule City West)
summary_en: A cappella mixed choir of about 20 members, singing Renaissance to pop, rehearsing on Mondays in the Salvatorkirche parish hall. No conductor call published.

name: Ayabás Frauenchor Berlin (Musikschule City West)
summary_en: Women's choir focused on Brazilian choral music, rehearsing on Wednesdays at the music school, with voice training on Mondays. A few places are open for experienced singers.

name: Kammerchor Memoria (Kaiser-Wilhelm-Gedächtnis-Kirche)
summary_en: Project-based chamber choir at the Gedächtniskirche, founded in 2023, with about four rehearsals per project. Singers join by audition; no teacher call published.

name: musikplus! Musikschule am Lietzensee

offer.title: musikplus Berlin seeks committed music teachers (guitar, piano, voice, drums, violin or other)

summary_en: Private music school near the Lietzensee teaching keyboard, wind, string, plucked and percussion instruments, plus choir. Its jobs page invites guitar, piano, voice, drums and violin teachers to apply by email.

name: musik atelier (Privatmusikschule)
summary_en: Private music school in Charlottenburg teaching piano, voice, guitar, violin and recorder, plus early musical education for young children. No job page found.

name: Heinz-Berggruen-Gymnasium
summary_en: State gymnasium with a music profile, a wind band class (Bläserklasse) with extra weekly instrumental lessons, and choir, orchestra and big band. No teacher vacancy found.

name: Friedensburg-Oberschule (Staatliche Europa-Schule Berlin)
summary_en: State secondary school with a music department where small groups learn string, wind or plucked instruments from the school collection, taught by external instrument teachers. No vacancy found.

name: Kirchenmusik Neu-Westend (Kantorei, Bläserensemble, Silberklänge)
summary_en: Protestant parish with a Kantorei, a seniors' choir, the brass ensemble Kreuz#Blech and a seniors' string ensemble, all meeting in the parish hall. No vacancy found on the page.

name: Kantorei und Kinderchor der Kirchengemeinde Am Lietzensee
summary_en: Parish choirs (Kantorei on Wednesdays, children's choir, Capella Cantorum) at the Lietzensee church; new singers are welcome. No teacher call found.

name: Kirchenmusik der Kirchengemeinde Epiphanien (Kantorei)
summary_en: Parish church music in Charlottenburg with a Kantorei, children's choirs and organ concerts. No rehearsal times or vacancies published on the page.

name: Karl-Forster-Chor Berlin
summary_en: Mixed concert choir that rehearses on Tuesday evenings in the parish hall of the Lindenkirche in Wilmersdorf. It runs project-based singing for experienced choristers.

name: Berliner Mozart-Chor (children's, Mozartini and youth choir)
summary_en: Independent youth choir with three age groups, rehearsing on Wednesdays in the Birger-Forell-Grundschule in Wilmersdorf. New singers can join at any time without an audition.

name: Golfchor Berlin-Brandenburg
summary_en: Amateur choir for golfers and friends that rehearses on Tuesday evenings in the Grunewald parish house. It works with a conductor and a piano accompanist.

name: Luisen-Vocalensemble
summary_en: Vocal ensemble that rehearses on Monday evenings in the Luisenkirche parish hall. The website has a page for prospective singers.

name: Junger Kammerchor Berlin e. V.
summary_en: Chamber choir of young adults that rehearses on Tuesdays at the Marie-Curie-Gymnasium in Wilmersdorf. It performs with orchestras, for example Bach's Magnificat in December 2026.

name: Chor Confetti e. V.
summary_en: Mixed amateur choir rehearsing on Wednesday evenings at the Friedensburg-Oberschule in Charlottenburg. The website invites new singers to join.

name: StudioChor Berlin e.V.
summary_en: Registered choir society that rehearses on Tuesday evenings at the Friedensburg-Oberschule in Charlottenburg. The site has pages on rehearsals and joining.

name: Cantus Domus
summary_en: Choir for contemporary and unusual concert formats that rehearses on Thursdays in the Lietzensee parish hall. The site has pages on joining and voice training.

name: Hugo-Distler-Chor Berlin e.V.
summary_en: Mixed choir attached to the Kirche am Hohenzollernplatz that rehearses on Thursday evenings. It offers voice training and invites guests to attend trial rehearsals.

name: Bulgarian Voices Berlin e.V.
summary_en: Women's choir singing Bulgarian folk repertoire, rehearsing on Wednesdays in the Sühne-Christi-Kirche in Charlottenburg-Nord. The site has a page for prospective singers.

name: Singing me happy (jazz choir)
summary_en: Jazz choir that rehearses on Thursday evenings at the IBZ in Wilmersdorf. The contact page has a mailbox for new members.

name: Berliner Kantorei and Berliner Motettenchor (Grunewald parish)
summary_en: Large amateur choir of about 80 singers and a smaller a cappella chamber choir, both based in the Grunewald parish house. The site publishes a role mailbox for those who want to sing.

name: Trinitatis-Kantorei (Lietzow parish)
summary_en: Parish choir of about 40 singers performing sacred music, rehearsing on Wednesdays in the Trinitatiskirche and parish hall. New members are welcome.

name: Trinitatis Posaunenchor (Lietzow parish)
summary_en: Parish brass band founded in 2014, with separate beginner and advanced rehearsals on Tuesdays in the Trinitatiskirche. Instruments can be lent for a fee.

name: Posaunenchor Alt-Lietzow (Luisen parish)
summary_en: Parish brass band with more than 60 years of history, rehearsing on Monday evenings in the Luisenkirche. It plays at services, parish festivals and concerts.

name: Die Schützlinge (instrumental group of the Trinitatis parish)
summary_en: Amateur orchestra with open instrumentation that meets twice a month on Fridays in the Trinitatiskirche. Players of nearly all instruments and ages are welcome.
